exposure: Induction of labor for suspected macrosomia
outcome: Neonatal complications (resuscitation in the delivery room, death in the delivery room or immediate postpartum, neonatal transfer to the NICU)
cohort: 3077 women without diabetes and with a cephalic singleton term pregnancy
finding: Induction of labor for suspected macrosomia did not reduce the occurrence of severe perineal tears, cesarean delivery rates, or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: A policy of inducing labor for women with a constitutionally large-for-gestational-age fetus did not reduce the cesarean delivery rate.
